name: Scout v4 probe bench kit
note: 15 Nov (engine worker, for the design chat): the probe bench kit as Spark assembles it, for tools/assembly_check.py only (off the page: check_only). The bench base and bench turret in place of the flight frame and turret, the drawn spool, pinion, roller, head frame and cradle, the bought N20, SG90, camera and LED bars; the 209 leaf, the M3 idler and the inserts are not drawn.

parts.name: probe spool with its 40 T gear (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_spool/make.py)
probe pinion, 12 T, on the N20's 3 mm D shaft (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_pinion/make.py)
N20 6 V 100 rpm gear motor (B07MZH851L; replaces the 300 rpm B0BZDC951L)
the head's cable, coiled loosely in the drum
the two blades from the spool up into the throat

the coil's pressure roller (drawn: parts/scout_v4_probe_roller/make.py): two printed O8 x 4.50 tubes turning on a O3 carbon rod 23.6 long (bore 3.3, no bearings), between them a printed saddle on the rod carrying a Keystone-209-type leaf contact (ZCZQC B0C5D3XLBK) against the pocket's fixed end wall
probe head frame: the clip on the blades' tip, the SG90's closed ring, the idler's bracket (drawn prototype, parts/scout_v4_head_frame/make.py)
probe tilt servo: SG90 (DORHEA, B0DFKPVRC2) and its 470 uF capacitor
the SG90's single-arm horn and its centre screw (from its bag), screwed to the cradle's +y wall
parts.note: on the SG90's spline, its arm in the cradle's channel (parts/scout_v4_head_lib.py): it turns with the cradle

parts.name: probe camera: Arducam 12MP autofocus USB in its metal case (B0FLX58WKZ; bracket off)
probe light: two 25 x 8 mm bars of Clearhill 5 V COB strip, 4000 K, CRI 90 (B0F1YPP6QS)

contacts.why: the 40 / 12 gear mesh: the teeth are drawn at an arbitrary phase
the head's cable coil is drawn as a solid ring over the drum's O8 hub (a loose coil, nothing printed in it)
the blades leave the wound coil at its tangent (the feed drawn from the coil's surface)
the horn's hub on the SG90's spline, 0.25 off the case on the spline's shoulder (the spline itself not drawn)

mates.why: the cradle turns between the head frame's brackets
the pinion's D bore on the N20's 3.0 / 2.5 D shaft
the spool turns between the bench turret's side plates

paths.name: bench turret onto the bench base
paths.why: the bench turret with its spool, gears, N20, drum, roller and feed down onto the base (its floor bosses on the base's inserts)

paths.name: blades into the head frame's clip
paths.why: the two blades' tips (the lens, 2 x 2.78 thick, 19 wide) slide up into the head frame's 14 mm clip

paths.name: SG90 into the head frame's ring
paths.why: step 2 (parts/scout_v4_head_lib.py): the SG90 with its horn slid +y into the frame's closed ring from the cradle's room, its tabs stop on the ring's face

paths.name: camera into the cradle (in hand)
paths.why: step 3: the case slid into the cradle from behind until its front meets the lip, the cradle still off the head (Spark 15 Nov: it could not)

paths.name: cradle lowered onto the horn
paths.why: step 5: the cradle with the camera and LED bars at nod 0 lowered straight down between the bracket and the SG90, the horn's arm, hub and centre screw sliding up its channel from the open bottom edge; with the horn here (shown lifted out together; head_frame/make.py checks the channel over the horn)

paths.name: head nods -20..+90 deg
paths.why: the cradle, camera and LED bars about the SG90's axis from 20 down to 90 up (parked 15 up)
